rows: Domestic_Tourism-Accommodation 1788 (336 with data); Inbound_Tourism-Accommodation 1788 (490); Inbound_Tourism-Arrivals 1346 (617); Inbound_Tourism-Expenditure 898 (573); Inbound_Tourism-Purpose 1123 (562); Inbound_Tourism-Regions 2461 (1563); Outbound_Tourism-Departures 1119 (229); Outbound_Tourism-Expenditure 898 (585); Tourism_Industries 1789 (1032). Rows are wide UNWTO Compendium layout: country header rows, section rows, and indicator rows; '..' = missing.
columns: C. (country code); S. (series code); C. & S.; Basic data and indicators (country name); 4 unnamed indicator-hierarchy cols; Units; Notes; Series (VF/TF/TCE flags, some files); 1995..2022 year columns; trailing empty col. Semicolon-delimited, UTF-8 BOM, thousands separators as commas.
date_range: Annual 1995 to 2022 (year columns); no finer grain
how_pulled: gh api repos/Daniele1388/DWH---Global-Tourism-Project/contents/Datasets (tree listing); curl -sL -o <name>.csv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daniele1388/DWH---Global-Tourism-Project/main/Datasets/<name>.csv for 9 of 14 CSVs plus README.md; python pandas read_csv(sep=';', encoding='utf-8-sig') to count rows/columns/years
full_dataset_size: 14 CSVs, ~4.3 MB total (largest SDG_12b1.csv 1.7 MB); repo 2.3 MB packed. Not pulled: Domestic Tourism-Trips (131 KB), Inbound Tourism-Transport (177 KB), SDG 8.9.1 (252 KB), SDG 8.9.2 (213 KB), SDG_12b1 (1.7 MB). Underlying source is the UN Tourism (UNWTO) Compendium of Tourism Statistics / Key Tourism Statistics dataset (unwto.org/tourism-statistics/key-tourism-statistics), free Excel download, updated annually.
description: UN Tourism (UNWTO) Compendium of Tourism Statistics exported as wide semicolon CSVs: one row per country x indicator, one column per year 1995-2022, covering ~226-230 countries and territories. Tables sampled: inbound arrivals (total, overnight, same-day, cruise), arrivals by origin region, inbound purpose (business vs personal), inbound and outbound expenditure (travel and passenger transport, USD mn), outbound departures, domestic and inbound guests/overnights in hotels and similar establishments, and tourism-industry supply (establishments, rooms, bed-places, occupancy rates, average length of stay). For ABNB it is a long annual cross-country panel for gap #7 (LatAm/APAC travel volume) and for cross-border share and hotel-supply context per country; it is annual and ends in 2022, so it is background/structural, not a nowcast input.
issues: Annual only and stops at 2022 (the current UNWTO release runs to 2023/2024, so this mirror is stale versus the free source). Layout is a spreadsheet export, not tidy: country code column has Excel-mangled date strings (e.g. 'Apr-00' for code 4), indicator hierarchy spread across 4 unnamed columns, values are strings with comma thousands separators and '..' for missing; needs a reshape before use. Repo licence is MIT but the data are UN Tourism's; UNWTO terms permit non-commercial/educational use with attribution -- fine for a student pitch, check before any redistribution. Repo last pushed 2026-04-22.
